description: Recent records from a common City of Montreal open dataset (donnees.montreal.ca, CKAN) by friendly name. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime in Montreal", "Montreal 311 requests", "Montreal building permits". Names: 311, crime, permits. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Pass `q` for a free-text filter; for full control use montreal_query.

q.description: Optional free-text filter across all columns (CKAN full-text), e.g. "larceny" or a neighborhood.

name: montreal_recent
